goal: Review and build web forms that browsers and password managers can fill: autocomplete tokens, input types, la…
use: Review and build web forms that browsers and password managers can fill: autocomplete tokens, input types, labels, validation and error feedback, one-time codes, IME-safe submit, and customizable form controls. Use when building or reviewing sign-in, sign-up, checkout, address or any data-entry form.
prompt: Use the rlm-web-forms-autofill skill on the records for this review.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
cons: Not checked: Behaviour in specific password managers and browsers, server-side validation outside the scope, and SMS delivery for one-time codes.

steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each form is placed by whether its fields carry autocomplete tokens.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Payment fields with no autocomplete token
findings.fix: Add the autocomplete tokens for card fields

outcome.notChecked: Behaviour in specific password managers and browsers, server-side validation outside the scope, and SMS delivery for one-time codes.

protocol.title: Inspect
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py scan <corpus>`. Note the file count, line count and top-level folders. If the corpus is very large, agree the scope with the user, then narrow it with `--include 'src/*'` (repeatable) on every command. Files over 20 MB are skipped; `--max-bytes N` changes the limit. Report what `scan` lists as skipped.

protocol.title: Partition
protocol.text: Run `WORK=$(mktemp -d)`, then `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py chunk <corpus> "$WORK/chunks"`. Chunks are limited to 800 lines and 100,000 characters each, and are cut between definitions where possible. Each `chunk_NNN.md` holds the data notice and labelled file sections. `manifest.json` lists the chunks.

protocol.title: Map
protocol.text: For each chunk, run a fresh sub-task (a subagent if you can start one) that sees only that chunk file and the "Chunk task" below. It writes `"$WORK/out/<chunk>.out.md"`. If you cannot start sub-tasks, run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py pending "$WORK/chunks" "$WORK/out"`. It lists the chunks that still have no output. Process the first one: read it, write its output, then run `pending` again. Repeat until nothing is pending. Never hold all chunks in context at once.

protocol.title: Reduce
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py merge "$WORK/out" --out "$WORK/merged.json"`. If it lists `failed_outputs`, re-run those chunks. A missing or invalid output is not "no findings". Checks that span files (a duplicate across manifests, a route missing from a contract, a pattern repeated across chunks) are done on the merged list in this step. If the merged list is still too large to read, repeat steps 2 to 4 on the findings.

protocol.title: Verify
protocol.text: Re-read each cited line. Where a framework renders the form, check the attributes in the component code. For any missing validation or sanitising finding, trace the data to the sink.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: Write the report in the format below.

protocol.title: Clean up
protocol.text: Delete `$WORK` after the report is delivered.
